title: Pager page rekey and flag replacement

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerRekey replaces the complete page flag state and moves a live cache page to a distinct positive page number.

external_source_responsibilities: Page cache owns collision eviction, hash rekey, and dirty-list repositioning
B-tree balancing supplies live dirty writable pages and source-derived replacement flags
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete flag replacement and cache-move body is assigned and exercised against a live runtime Pager/cache owner.

outputs: ResultCode and rekeyed page on success
contracts.ownership: Page and its data remain cache-owned; no allocation or ownership transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: Reject zero, unchanged, unreferenced, or foreign-cache pages. Replace Page.flags before delegating the hash-key move. On success the old key is absent, the new key resolves to the same page, and need-sync dirty pages move to the dirty-list front.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Cache.move serializes through the cache group lock; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Typed precondition failures return misuse. Cache collision or ownership failures preserve a bounded exact ResultCode.

representation_differences: Zig accepts the typed page_cache.Flags structure rather than a u16 bit mask.
Zig returns ResultCode so release-mode precondition and cache invariant failures do not depend only on C assertions.

oracle.protocol: Acquire live page 1, mark it dirty, replace its flags with dirty/writeable/need-sync, rekey to page 2, require exact flags, old-key absence, new-key identity, and balanced reference release.
oracle.normalization: Page numbers, flag bits, result code, and within-process page identity compare exactly.

assurance.oom: No allocation in rekey; cache hash storage is pre-existing.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; cache group lock serializes hash and dirty-list mutation.
assurance.malformed_input: Zero, unchanged, unreferenced, and foreign-cache inputs are rejected.
assurance.continuation: Successful page remains live under the new key and can be cleaned/released normally.
assurance.performance: Expected constant-time hash rekey plus bounded collision cleanup.

integration.native_call_path: Runtime Pager owns the typed rekey operation; full B-tree balance sorting remains to be routed through it.

independent_review.notes: Requires B-tree balance integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Route native B-tree balance page-number sorting through Pager.rekeyPage.
Add pinned-C collision and dirty-list ordering trace.
